# Elements by 456 — Full Site Content

> Elements by 456 is a lakefront restaurant and patio bar in Gun Barrel City, Texas, on Cedar Creek Lake. Elevated comfort food, handcrafted cocktails, the largest bar on the lake, and live entertainment. Menu prices and event dates change often; the live menu is at https://elementsccl.com/menu and the live calendar is at https://elementsccl.com/events.

## Business facts

- Name: Elements by 456
- Type: Restaurant and bar (lakefront, indoor + patio dining)

## Home (https://elementsccl.com/)

Strong Drinks. Bold Flavor. Big Vibes. Gun Barrel City's ultimate lakefront social destination.

First time here? Elements by 456 offers indoor and patio dining, the largest bar on Cedar Creek Lake, live music and comedy nights, karaoke nights, and elevated comfort food with crafted cocktails.

The Experience: Main Dining (our indoor dining room, brunch through dinner), the Oasis Patio Bar (the largest and most beautiful bar on the lake), the Patriot Bar (honoring our service men and women), and craft cocktails from mixologists who create moments, not just drinks.

Food That Hits Different: comfort food, elevated. From brunch to dinner, every dish is made with fresh, quality ingredients and bold Texas flavor. Everything is fried in beef tallow.

Signature dishes: Mother Clucker (crispy fried or grilled chicken with pickles and garlic aioli on a brioche bun), Brisket Jam Burger (smoked brisket, bacon jam, cheddar, roasted garlic aioli), Queso Gone Wild (smoked brisket folded into creamy queso with pico and jalapeños), Cinnamon Crunch Cake (the legendary dessert).

Always Something Happening: the next upcoming events from the live calendar, plus live music, karaoke night, and private events.

## Menu (https://elementsccl.com/menu)

Three menus, managed live: Brunch (Sat & Sun 11am–2pm), Midday (Mon, Thu, Fri 11am–3pm) and Dinner (from 4pm). Fan favorites include Blueberry Beignets with lemon icing, the 456 Cheeseburger, Jack'd & Loaded, and Chocolate Fudge Brownie. Items marked with a star are house favorites; "GF" marks gluten-free items. Handhelds can be made a basket for +$4. Everything is fried in beef tallow.

## Specials (https://elementsccl.com/specials)

- Happy Hour: 3–6pm, every day we're open — drink deals at the largest bar on Cedar Creek Lake.
- Taco Thursday & $5 Margaritas: a weekly Elements social, every Thursday.
- Burger Monday: $1 off any burger and another $1 off when you add fries (dinner only).
- Elements After 5: premium steaks, seafood, and distinctive evening dishes for dinner.
- Featured specials: rotating chef features such as Steak & Shrimp, Salmon, Blackened Mahi Mahi, Filet Mignon, Steak Medallions and Pancakes — ask your server what's on this week.
- Coming up: entertainment pulled live from the events calendar.

## Events (https://elementsccl.com/events)

What's Happening at Elements: a calendar view and an upcoming list of live music, karaoke, comedy and special events, filterable by category. All times are local to Gun Barrel City. Dates come directly from the restaurant's public Google Calendar and update within minutes of changes. Find your night: Live Music, Karaoke Nights, Private Events & Parties, Perform at Elements.

## Live Music (https://elementsccl.com/live-music)

Live music at Elements — weekend nights on the patio, the lake comes alive. The upcoming lineup lists who's playing next on the patio stage. There's nothing like live music under the open sky on Cedar Creek Lake; the patio stage brings local and touring acts right to your table. Tables fill up fast on music nights — reserve ahead.

## Karaoke Night (https://elementsccl.com/karaoke-night)

Take the mic. Own the room. Upcoming karaoke nights are listed from the calendar. Karaoke is better with friends: reserve a group table for birthdays, team outings, or a weeknight tradition. No cover. Just courage.

## Oasis Patio Bar (https://elementsccl.com/oasis-patio-bar)

The largest and most beautiful bar on Cedar Creek Lake: sprawling outdoor space with panoramic lake views and seating for hundreds; signature hand-crafted cocktails from classics to house originals; live music, string lights, lakeside breezes and the best sunsets in East Texas. From smoked old fashioneds to tropical frozen concoctions, every sip is an experience.

## Patriot Bar (https://elementsccl.com/patriot-bar)

A tribute to the men and women who have served and continue to serve. Every detail reflects respect for the military, first responders and their families. Values: honoring service, community first, built with respect. Veterans, families and neighbors — all welcome.

## About (https://elementsccl.com/about)

Elements By 456 is more than a restaurant—it's where the Cedar Creek Lake community comes together. Rooted in a local family with seven generations of history in this community, we created Elements for people who love great food, cold drinks, live music, comedy, and good company. From brunch and happy hour to dinner, karaoke, live entertainment, and special events, there's always something happening here. We also host private parties, showers, business gatherings, and other special occasions, with catering available both on-site and off-site. Our spaces: Main Dining (indoor dining room), the Oasis Patio Bar, and the Patriot Bar.

## Reservations (https://elementsccl.com/reservations)

Save your seat. Walk-ins are always welcome, but reservations are recommended—especially for live music, karaoke, comedy, and other special-event nights. Book online through the Toast reservations widget, or call (903) 910-7666. Special occasions — birthdays, anniversaries, celebrations — can be booked as private events.

## Catering & Private Events (https://elementsccl.com/catering)

Make your event an Elements event: birthdays, showers, anniversary celebrations, corporate gatherings, luncheons, and holiday parties, with private-event space, customized food options, and full bar service. On-site and off-site catering options are available. Request a booking through the form; the team responds within 24 hours, or call (903) 910-7666.

## Perform at Elements (https://elementsccl.com/entertainment-inquiry)

Musicians, DJs, comedians and promoters can bring their act to the biggest stage on Cedar Creek Lake. We book bands and musicians (country, rock, blues, acoustic — solo acts to full bands), DJs, comedians and hosts (DJ nights, comedy showcases, karaoke and trivia hosts), and promoters and event partners. Submit the entertainment inquiry form with your act and availability.

## Join Our Team (https://elementsccl.com/careers)

Elements By 456 is a locally owned restaurant and entertainment destination serving the Cedar Creek Lake community in Gun Barrel City, always interested in dependable, hardworking people with a positive attitude and a heart for hospitality. Never a dull shift; one team, one goal; opportunities to grow. Apply through the short online application.
